dependencies.basis: TurkStat's national accounts (including the ESA 2010 / SNA 2008 series) are compiled following the international guidelines of SNA 2008 and ESA 2010 for GDP calculation by production, expenditure and income approaches, supply-use balancing, and regional accounts. Evidence: "The international guidelines applied in the calculation of GDP are ESA 2010 and SNA 2008. ... The most recent standards guiding these revisions are the System of National Accounts (2008 SNA) and the European System of Accounts (ESA 2010)."
dependencies.evidence_quote: The international guidelines applied in the calculation of GDP are ESA 2010 and SNA 2008.

dependencies.basis: National Accounts of Turkey (GDP) are produced within TurkStat's System of National Accounts in line with SNA 2008 (and ESA 2010) concepts, definitions and balancing procedures. Evidence: "In Türkiye, estimations related to the National Accounts System are in line with SNA and ESA guidelines. ... The international guidelines applied in the calculation of GDP are ESA 2010 and SNA 2008."
dependencies.evidence_quote: In Türkiye, estimations related to the National Accounts System are in line with SNA and ESA guidelines.

dependencies.basis: Provincial Gross Regional Domestic Product estimates (including Istanbul) are compiled as regional accounts in accordance with SNA 2008, ESA 2010 and the Regional Accounts Manual, using the same conceptual framework and balancing as national GDP. Evidence: "Regional accounts are compiled in accordance with the System of National Accounts (SNA- 2008) published by the United Nations, the European System of Accounts (ESA-2010) applied in European Union member countries, and the Regional Accounts Manual."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Regional accounts are compiled in accordance with the System of National Accounts (SNA- 2008) published by the United Nations, the European System of Accounts (ESA-2010) applied in European Union member countries, and the Regional Accounts Manual.

dependencies.basis: Türkiye's Balance of Payments statistics are compiled by the CBRT according to the concepts, definitions, classifications and presentation of BPM6. Evidence: "Balance of payments and international investment position statistics are compiled in accordance with the international standards set forth in the “Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th Edition (BPM6)”, which is prepared by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) to provide guidance to member countries."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Balance of payments and international investment position statistics are compiled in accordance with the international standards set forth in the “Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th Edition (BPM6)”, which is prepared by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) to provide guidance to member countries.

dependencies.basis: The CPI classification structure has been switched to COICOP-2018 (and weights derived consistently with it) to align with international standards and Eurostat requirements for candidate countries. Evidence: "With the change in the base year, it has been decided to switch from the current classification structure used in the CPI to the Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP-2018), which better reflects current consumption patterns. ... The methodology of the CPI is based on the International Monetary Fund (IMF) Consumer Price Index Handbook."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Baz yılının değişmesi ile birlikte TÜFE’de halen kullanılmakta olan mevcut sınıflama yapısı yerine, güncel tüketim kalıplarını daha iyi yansıtan Amaca Göre Bireysel Tüketim Sınıflaması COICOP-2018’e geçilmesine karar verilmiştir.

dependencies.basis: In the expenditure approach to GDP, data on exports and imports of services are taken from the CBRT Balance of Payments statistics. Evidence: "Data on exports and imports of goods are sourced from Turkish Statistical Institute (TurkStat) Foreign Trade Statistics, while data on service exports and imports are obtained from the Central Bank Balance of Payments statistics."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Data on exports and imports of goods are sourced from Turkish Statistical Institute (TurkStat) Foreign Trade Statistics, while data on service exports and imports are obtained from the Central Bank Balance of Payments statistics.

dependencies.basis: Major source data for goods trade, freight/insurance, international trade in services and short-term trade credits in the BOP are provided by TurkStat foreign-trade and related statistics. Evidence: "The major sources of the balance of payments statistics are; ... Foreign trade statistics compiled by the Turkstat, ... Credit and debit figures on freight and insurance regarding merchandise trade provided by the Turkstat, ... Credit and debit figures on International Trade in Services Statistics provided by the Turkstat, ... Short-term trade credits compiled by the Turkstat using direct reporting method"
dependencies.evidence_quote: Foreign trade statistics compiled by the Turkstat

dependencies.basis: National accounts use CBRT BOP data for the services component of exports and imports in the expenditure approach and for consistency checks. Evidence: "Data on exports and imports of goods are sourced from Turkish Statistical Institute (TurkStat) Foreign Trade Statistics, while data on service exports and imports are obtained from the Central Bank Balance of Payments statistics."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Data on exports and imports of goods are sourced from Turkish Statistical Institute (TurkStat) Foreign Trade Statistics, while data on service exports and imports are obtained from the Central Bank Balance of Payments statistics.

dependencies.basis: The Central Bank of Iran publishes annual national accounts by activity and institutional sector on the basis of the System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA 2008), with base year 1395. Evidence: "حسابهای ملی سالانه ایران به تفکیک بخش‌های فعالیتی و نهادی اقتصاد بر مبنای نظام حسابهای ملی 2008 به قیمت‌ها‌ی جاری و ثابت سال پایه 1395 ... تهیه و تدوین ارقام بر مبنای آخرین نسخه استاندارد نظام حساب‌های ملی 2008 (SNA)" Read in Thomas's Chrome 2026-09-04 (cbi.ir is F5-walled to every scripted fetch): the page is the CBI Economic Accounts Department's own note on the SNA 2008-based annual accounts; the sentence in evidence_quote is verbatim from it. Graded B by hand, not A — the grader cannot raw-fetch this host, so the A bar (quote found by the script in the cited document) is not checkable.
dependencies.evidence_quote: اداره حساب‌های اقتصادی در راستای ارتقاء و بهنگام سازی آمار حساب‌های ملی مطابق با آخرین نسخه دستورالعمل استاندارد نظام حساب‌های ملی سازمان ملل متحد، پیاده سازی نظام حساب‌های ملی 2008 را از اواخر سال 1396 در دستور کار خود قرار داد.
